declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 null,
 null, 
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');

 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_Date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_Date) and
 attrib_group = 'PHER';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0095');
 check_package_failure;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time
 into temp_bleed_start_time, temp_bleed_end_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_bleed_start_time is null or
 temp_bleed_end_time is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0065');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 end if;
 if temp_count < 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 show_error('0135');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

end;

Item.Name: PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for product code or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_set_id number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_valid_set VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_valid_prod VARCHAR2(1);
 cursor c1 is
 select set_id from product_matrix
 where product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and bag_code <= :GLOBAL.bag_code;
 cursor c2 is
 select distinct product_code
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 product_code != 'NONE' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 relabel_product_code is null;
 -- notice that the where clause excludes pooled
 -- component clause because they are actual components made
 -- from that unit; relabeled components are not
 -- considered in the search for the valid set combination
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
 
begin
 /* new tz function.
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 */
 
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function.
 
 nullchk;
 check_package_Failure;
 begin
 select product_code, product_desc, product_type, specific_gravity
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :s_product_code_desc, :product_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.sp_gravity
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365) ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
 select nvl(weight_required, 'N')
 into :ctrl_blk_1.weight_required
 from valid_product_types
 where product_type_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365) ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;


 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,v_sysdate+365)
 and product_type != 'CRYO'
 and nvl(pheresis_flag,'N') = 'N'
 and product_type not in
 (select product_type
 from components, valid_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 components.product_code =
 valid_products.product_code);
 /* notice that the where clause excludes relabel and pooled
 component clause because they are actual products made
 from that unit */
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code :=
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code;
 show_error('0155');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 for temp_set in c1
 loop
 -- message ('Set ID = '||to_char(temp_set.set_id));
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 temp_valid_prod := 'Y';
 for temp_prod in c2
 loop
 -- message ('Product Code= '||temp_prod.product_code);
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from product_matrix
 where set_id=temp_set.set_id
 and product_type = 
 ( SELECT product_type
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = temp_prod.product_code
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- message('Incorrect prod for this set');
 temp_valid_prod := 'N';
 exit;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in product_matrix data');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 if temp_valid_prod = 'Y'
 then
 -- message
 -- ('Valid Set Found = '||to_char(temp_set.set_id));
 temp_valid_set := 'Y';
 exit;
 else
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 end if;
 end loop;
 if temp_valid_set != 'Y'
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :ctrl_blk_1.product_code;
 show_error('0137');
 check_package_failure;
 -- message('Err: Not a valid combination of product.');
 -- raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.product_type in ('DUFFP','RPFF','CPPLS','FFP') THEN
 check_time_limit;
 END IF;
end;

declare

begin
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip

 begin

 :s_bag_id_desc := '';
 if :s_bag_id != 'M'
 then

 when OTHERS

 --If Primary bag - check that the bag is the same as the checked in Bag
 declare
 temp_x varchar2(1);

 select 'x' into temp_x

 and code = :Bag_Id
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'));

 and bag_code = :bag_id;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_time_limit is
 temp_time number;
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;

begin
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 select a.time_limit
 into temp_time
 from chapters b, valid_products a, units u
 where b.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and a.product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5)
 and u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and ((to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') - u.bleed_start_time) + (b.ffp_freeze_durn/24)) > (a.time_limit/24);
 show_error('9792');
exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RECONCILE_BAGS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure reconcile_bags(p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date ,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 r_empty_bags in out number ,
 r_bag_code in out varchar2) is
 temp_no_of_discards number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
 temp_no_of_bags number;
begin
 -- to check if the bag code
 select nvl(to_number(substr(bag_code, -1)), --For obtaining the last digit of the bag code
 decode(contract_id,'INTERNAL',null,1))
 + nvl(add_on_bags,0)
 into temp_no_of_bags
 from units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 begin
 select nvl(sum(nvl(bags_used,1)*
 decode(substr(product_code, 1, 5),'NONE',1,0)),0),
 nvl(sum(nvl(bags_used,1)*
 decode(substr(product_code, 1, 5),'NONE',0,1)),0)
 into temp_no_of_discards, temp_no_of_comp
 from components
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_no_of_bags := temp_no_of_bags - temp_no_of_discards;
 r_empty_bags := temp_no_of_bags - temp_no_of_comp;
 if temp_no_of_bags > 4
 then
 r_bag_code := '4';
 else
 r_bag_code := substr(to_char(temp_no_of_bags,'9'),2);
 end if;
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

 (SELECT DISTINCT product_type

 )

 component clause because they are actual products made from that
 unit */
ORDER BY 3,1
